Definition: Lehabim, a son of Mizraim, and his descendants
BiblicalUsage: Lᵉhâbîym means Lehabim, a son of Mizraim, and his descendants — a small word with a sharp edge. In Genesis 10:13, "and Lehabim"; and in 1 Chronicles 1:11, "and Lehabim".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lehabim stands in the table of nations as proof that God traces every people back to one family.
